Opening. A singer at the night market opens her mouth and nothing comes out.

Threat. The Quiet Man (import it from the Threats compendium).

Innocent. Grace Ellery, a radio host whose voice is famous across Larkhaven.

Hidden place. The old radio tower in the Heights. Public place. The Friday night market.

The full episode (leads, Life calls, places, twist and closing) is in the rulebook, Part Three.

Opening. A row of old houses burns in the shape of a wedding ring.

Threat. The Ash Widow (import it from the Threats compendium).

Innocent. Hannah Price, a firefighter, getting married next week.

Hidden place. The burned-out theatre on the Docks. Public place. The harbour fireworks.

The full episode (leads, Life calls, places, twist and closing) is in the rulebook, Part Three.

Opening. Three people walk into the sea at dusk, singing.

Threat. The Drowned Choir (import it from the Threats compendium).

Innocent. Kit Marlow, a twelve-year-old who sings in the school choir.

Hidden place. The drowned village in Saltmarsh at low tide. Public place. The long pier at dusk.

The full episode (leads, Life calls, places, twist and closing) is in the rulebook, Part Three.
